name: 11-Ketotestosterone

card.summary: A natural adrenal-derived androgen, equipotent to testosterone at the androgen receptor, discussed in bodybuilding circles for muscle and body composition.
card.note: Studied as a hormone in endocrine disorders, not as a muscle-building treatment.

quick.overview:
11-Ketotestosterone is an oxidised form of testosterone made from adrenal precursors. Endocrinology papers describe it as a bioactive androgen with potency equal to testosterone that, unlike testosterone, does not decline with age.

Bodybuilding forums discuss it as an androgen with a possible role in body composition. Published human research concerns its role in conditions of androgen excess, not its use for physique.
quick.how: In research it is measured in blood and urine. A related compound, 11-ketoandrostenedione, is sold online as a prohormone. No dosing is described here.
quick.risks: No human trials of 11-ketotestosterone as a physique supplement were found. Androgen excess conditions where it is raised, such as polycystic ovary syndrome and congenital adrenal hyperplasia, are discussed in the literature.

lead: 11-Ketotestosterone (11-KT) is an oxidised form of testosterone with a keto group at carbon 11, made mainly from 11-beta-hydroxyandrostenedione and, to a lesser extent, from 11-ketoandrostenedione [1]. In fish it is the main androgen, while in mammals it is an important adrenal-derived androgen [1].

Endocrinology reviews describe 11-KT and its 5-alpha-reduced product, 11-ketodihydrotestosterone, as bioactive androgens with potencies comparable to testosterone and dihydrotestosterone. They are made largely in peripheral tissues from an adrenal precursor, and, unlike classic androgens, their circulating levels do not decline with age [2]. They are discussed as major contributors to androgen excess disorders such as congenital adrenal hyperplasia, premature adrenarche and polycystic ovary syndrome, and to castration-resistant prostate cancer [2].

Appearance interest comes from androgens' role in lean mass, body fat distribution and the features they drive, and from its androgen receptor activity. Wikipedia describes 11-KT as very weakly anabolic and mainly protective against muscle breakdown [1]. A transdermal supplement sold under the name 11-T was promoted in the 2000s by the T Nation supplement company's staff for muscle and body composition [6][7][8]. Published human research has measured 11-KT as a hormone marker; no trials have tested it as a physique supplement.

angle.text: Androgens are tied to lean mass and fat distribution, which is why 11-KT is discussed for body composition. Published research examines it as a hormone marker, not a physique tool.

infobox: Comparable to testosterone at the androgen receptor [2]
Circulating level does not decline with age [2]

paras: After puberty the adrenal glands were long regarded as minor sources of sex steroids, with DHEA and DHEA sulfate as the main precursors, which are biologically inactive. Research since the 2010s identified 11-beta-hydroxyandrostenedione as the second most abundant unconjugated adrenal androgen and 11-KT as its active downstream product, formed mostly in peripheral tissues [2].

11-KT is recognised as an adrenarchal androgen, one of the hormones involved in the maturational rise in adrenal androgen production that begins in early childhood and that contributes to pubic hair and sebaceous and apocrine gland development [4].
In fish, 11-KT is the main androgenic sex hormone; for example, midshipman males of the later-maturing type differ from the other male type in their testosterone levels, and females lack it [1].

11-KT is formed in peripheral tissues from adrenal-derived 11-hydroxyandrostenedione and is a bioactive androgen [2]. Its hepatic metabolism and urinary metabolites were characterised in a 2025 study of an oral androgen challenge [3].

In a comparison of 114 women with polycystic ovary syndrome and 49 controls, 11-oxygenated androgens were elevated and made up 53.0 percent of total serum androgens in PCOS versus 44.0 percent in controls; two of them correlated with markers of insulin resistance [5].

Reviews also describe 11-oxygenated androgens in congenital adrenal hyperplasia, premature adrenarche and androgen-dependent prostate tumours that persist after castration [2]. These findings explain why endocrinologists measure them in blood and urine; they do not describe 11-KT as a treatment.
A related compound, 11-ketoandrostenedione, has been sold online as a prohormone under names like 11-oxo [1].

The Biotest company that sells through T Nation marketed a transdermal spray called 11-T around 2009 to 2011, and forum threads from the period show members asking whether it worked and why information about it had disappeared [6][8]. A staff member wrote in one thread that 11-KT activates the androgen receptor even more than testosterone for a given level of free hormone [8], and in another that it has some muscle-building value relative to natural levels but not relative to a steroid stack, and that it is probably at least partly suppressive of testosterone production, which he said was not measured [7]. Another poster called it expensive and somewhat weak [7].
These accounts are product-community claims. Reference works describe 11-KT as very weakly anabolic [1], and the published endocrinology literature does not report use of 11-KT for body composition.

No studies found of 11-ketotestosterone as a muscle or appearance treatment. Clinical research focuses on its measurement in congenital adrenal hyperplasia, adrenarche, PCOS and prostate cancer [2][3].

timeline.event: T Nation forum members discuss the 11-T product and its reported effects [6][7].
Biotest staff discuss the pricing and recommended use of 11-T on the forum [8].
A study finds 11-oxygenated androgens make up 53.0 percent of total androgens in PCOS [5].
Nature Reviews Endocrinology reviews 11-oxygenated androgens in health and disease [2].
A study characterises hepatic metabolism and urinary metabolites of 11-oxygenated androgens in humans [3].

lore.intro: On T Nation, 11-ketotestosterone is discussed mainly through a Biotest transdermal product called 11-T and its possible muscle effects [6][7][8].

claims.claim: 11-KT builds muscle more than testosterone at the androgen receptor
claims.believers: A staff post says it activates the androgen receptor even more than testosterone for a given free hormone level [8].
claims.experts: Wikipedia describes 11-KT as very weakly anabolic, mainly preventing breakdown; reviews describe its androgen receptor potency as comparable to testosterone [1][2].

claims.claim: 11-KT has some muscle value but is weaker than steroids
claims.believers: A staff member says it has value relative to natural levels, not relative to a steroid stack; another poster calls it expensive and somewhat weak [7].
claims.experts: No human trial has tested 11-KT for muscle.

claims.claim: 11-KT may suppress natural testosterone and may reduce fat
claims.believers: A staff member says it is almost undoubtedly at least partly suppressive and may help reduce fat by affecting cortisone conversion in fat tissue; the suppression was not measured [7].
claims.experts: No published studies have measured these effects of supplemental 11-KT.
